limitations: The sharp formula is proved only for subsets of the real line and uses its order structure. It does not give a same-constant higher-dimensional analogue, a converse quantitative lower bound on the optimal disconnectedness constant from dimension alone, or uniqueness of the central-Cantor extremizers.
